now.title: Spider-Man (1994)#57
now.text: The Chameleon betrays the Kingpin for his stepfather, the Red Skull.
now.on_a_card_about_b: A spy who can wear any face.

proposed.title: Spider-Man (1994)#55
proposed.text: In Moscow, the Chameleon poses as a witness's husband to steal the evidence about Peter's parents, then leads Spider-Man into the Insidious Six's trap.

changes.evidence: The current text (Chameleon betrays the Kingpin for the Red Skull, #57) is about the Chameleon and the Kingpin, not Peter. What passes between Peter and the Chameleon in this arc is in 'Unclaimed Legacy' (#55): the daughter's husband takes the evidence and turns out to be the Chameleon, who leads Spider-Man into a trap where the Insidious Six defeat him.

now.title: Spider-Man (1994)#51
now.text: Stress and his own experiments keep turning Connors back into the Lizard.
now.on_a_card_about_b: Peter's science teacher, who sometimes becomes the Lizard.
now.on_b_card_about_a: Connors's student. As Spider-Man, brings him back from the Lizard.

proposed.text: Peter and Mary Jane ask Connors to give her away at their wedding, but lizard creatures grown from his discarded DNA kidnap him, and he becomes the Lizard again.

changes.evidence: 'The Lizard King' (#51): Peter and Mary Jane ask Connors to give the bride away; three lizard warriors, which gained intelligence from DNA Connors poured down the sink, kidnap him and he turns into the Lizard again. Nothing on screen blames stress, and the current text leaves out what happens between Peter and Connors.

proposed.title: Spider-Man (1994)#61
proposed.text: On the Beyonder's world, the Lizard attacks Spider-Man until the heroes restore Connors's mind, and Connors joins Spider-Man's team.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Peter's science teacher. Joins Peter's team on the Beyonder's world.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Connors's student. As Spider-Man, leads the team Connors joins.

changes.evidence: 'Arrival' (#61): the Beyonder picks the Lizard as one of the villains; he attacks Spider-Man and is knocked out, then Iron Man and Mister Fantastic reactivate Connors's mind and Connors sides with Spider-Man's team.

proposed.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man#14
proposed.text: Working for the Master Planner, the Tinkerer helps Beck operate as Mysterio and builds the robot double that Spider-Man arrests in Beck's place.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Mysterio's partner. Builds his robot double.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: The Tinkerer's partner, who hides behind a robot double.

changes.evidence: 'Blueprints' (#14): Mysterio steals tech for the Master Planner; Spider-Man unmasks and arrests a mechanical replica, and afterward the Tinkerer tells the real Beck he can come out and scolds him for making the decoy in his own likeness.
